<span class="badge status-score-bearing">score-bearing</span>

> Uses MNIST with an explicit anomaly-AUROC target and a compact local autoencoder, matching the train-on-normal and score-by-reconstruction-error shape of the MLPerf Tiny anomaly-detection workload.

## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
uv run mlperf fetch --workload anomaly-ae-train --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload anomaly-ae-train --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload anomaly-ae-train --profile min

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload anomaly-ae-train --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

**Reviewer notes:**

- The public quality gate measures anomaly discrimination, not autoencoder training loss. Reconstruction MSE remains a diagnostic metric.
